data.description: The user releases their chakra past every natural limit, and it rises around them as a blazing star on wings of deep blue light. For a short time, every attack they make strikes with overwhelming force.
data.battleDescription: %user draws one slow breath and lets go of every limit, and chakra pours out of them faster than any body should hold. It gathers at their heart into a blazing four-pointed star, while great wings of deep blue chakra sweep upward around them, burning gold where they meet its light. The air trembles under the weight of that power, and every strike %user throws now carries all of it. For a few precious moments, there is no ceiling to %user's strength.

suggestion.title: New icon, animation and text
suggestion.rationale: The most-used jutsu in the game gets a premium icon (a white-hot star rising on wings of blue chakra, readable at small sizes), a matching cast animation (blue-and-gold wings frame the caster and the star glints above their head) in place of a stock violet effect shared with six other jutsu, and premium text. The old battle line ran five sentences listing the attack types it boosts and repeated the jutsu's name.
